meta.source: nflverse weekly_rosters + injuries + player_stats + nfldata schedules; Sleeper live status

adp.note: adp = 1QB (format matched to scoring), adpSf = 2QB/Superflex. Overall rank counts all positions incl. K/DST. FFC's yearly ADP is the final preseason window (see windows), i.e. after the preseason games.
adp.expPpg: per season+position log-linear fit of realized PPG (gp>=8) on 1QB ADP position rank; pooled fallback; applied to both formats

meta.earlyExit: week.exit=true when offensive snap share < 50% of the player's median share (>=3 other games, median >= 35%), the previous game was not already low, and he is listed/out the next game
meta.notes: DNP = did not play without any injury-report entry (healthy scratch / benching / zero-stat game) and is NOT counted as an injury; NR = not rostered; SUS = suspended/exempt. DNP, NR, SUS, BYE, FUT are excluded from availability math. Status O means the player did not play while on the report; the Friday designation is in desig.

weeks.inj: Not Injury Related - Returning From Suspension

injuries.type: Not Injury Related - Returning From Suspension
